hero.title: Smash your travel plans, not your mood.
hero.subtitle: AI-powered itineraries, kira-kira split bill, and instant re-planning when rain spoils your jalan-jalan. Steady, smart, and zero drama.
hero.imageAlt: Gebook interactive map and smart travel planner

map.title: The whole trip on one interactive map.
map.body: Every stop, pinned and numbered. From airport transit to hidden makan spots, check live weather and discover must-visit gems nearby.
map.imageAlt: Gebook itinerary map with numbered stops and routes

schedule.title: Day-by-day jalan-jalan at a glance.
schedule.body: One clean schedule per day - what time to move, which transit to take, where to lepak. Everything synced nicely for solo or geng trips.

budget.title: Kira-kira split bill without the drama.
budget.body: No more 'eh bro, transfer me later'. Log expenses as they happen - Gebook auto-splits costs and calculates the optimal settle-up in RM, SGD, JPY, or any currency.
budget.imageAlt: Shared expenses with multi-currency balance split

agent.title: Hujan or flight delay? Re-plan on the fly.
agent.body: Sudden downpour or delayed flight? Don't panic lah. Gebook AI re-routes your schedule to top indoor spots in seconds with one-click approval.
agent.imageAlt: Gebook AI agent suggesting real-time itinerary changes

collaborate.title: Sync preferences & vote together.
collaborate.body: No more 500 WhatsApp messages asking 'makan mana?'. Combine geng preferences, vote on activities, and share one simple invite link.

mobile.title: Your pocket travel companion everywhere you jalan.
mobile.body: Access your schedule, offline maps, and group expenses anywhere in the world on your mobile phone.

cta.title: Your next cuti is calling.
cta.subtitle: Join travellers planning stress-free adventures with Gebook - from weekend getaways to dream vacations.

footer.tagline: Gebook - Gepuk the chaos, book the dream.
